# llms.txt — AXIS IDE

> Repository: https://github.com/hoox-sh/axis-ide-vsce

Use these files for context before working on the AXIS IDE VS Code extension:

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) — high-signal agent guide: commands, constraints, security.
- [DESIGN.md](./DESIGN.md) — architecture, package boundaries, execution flow.
- [okf/index.md](./okf/index.md) — structured OKF knowledge bundle.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) — setup and checks.
- [PUBLISH.md](./PUBLISH.md) — maintainer publishing guide.

## Stack

- Runtime: Bun 1.4.4 + Node 22
- Host bundler: esbuild
- Webview bundler: Vite (one project per studio)
- Tests: `bun:test` for unit, `@vscode/test-electron` for integration
- Linter: Biome
- License: AGPL-3.0-only

## Sister projects

- HOOX execution mesh — https://github.com/hoox-sh/hoox
- PYNE Pine engine — https://github.com/hoox-sh/pyne
- AXIS charting PWA — https://github.com/hoox-sh/axis
